data_fields.name: meshUploadBudget
data_fields.donor_constant: 12 (ms per frame; at least one mesh always)

best_idea: Draw each part of a zone at the coarsest level whose finer children are all ready and in view, and swap in the children only as a complete set, so a late tile never leaves a hole and far tiles cost nothing.
decision_why: The ready-gated swap and the frustum prefilter fit a zone that streams tiles; the voxel meshing, GPU indirect path and occlusion passes do not fit the browser stack, so only the walk shape is kept; the wait gate that blanks the world is replaced by a cheap far layer.
acceptance: In a zone test with the camera turned 180 degrees, the draw list contains no tile whose box is wholly outside the four side planes (boxInFrustum false for each such tile); with seven of eight finer tiles loaded, the coarse tile is still in the draw list (no hole frame).
